english: Hello!
french: Bonjour !
russian: Приветствую!
bulgarian: Hello!

english: Saturday won't last forever, after all... and neither will these prices!
french: Le samedi ne va pas durer éternellement... Mes prix non plus !
russian: К тому же, субботний день не вечен... Как и эти цены!
bulgarian: Saturday won't last forever, after all... and neither will these prices!

english: I've got everything you need to live your best life, so come on down!
french: J'ai tout ce qu'il te faut pour te faciliter la vie, alors jette un œil !
russian: У меня есть всё, что вам нужно для идеальной жизни!
bulgarian: I've got everything you need to live your best life, so come on down!

english: Step right up, step right up! Welcome to Wheedle's carnival... of deals!
french: Approche, approche ! Bienvenue au grand carnaval des affaires de Wheedle !
russian: Подходите, подходите! Хлюст приветствует вас на карнавале... скидок!
bulgarian: Step right up, step right up! Welcome to Wheedle's carnival... of deals!

english: So have a look at my store and avail yourself of my charity. I promise you won't be disappointed.
french: Jette donc un œil à mes marchandises et profite de ma générosité. Tu ne seras pas déçu<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they>, je te le garantis.
russian: Спешите воспользоваться моей щедростью и присмотритесь к моим товарам. Обещаю, вы не будете разочарованы.
bulgarian: So have a look at my store and avail yourself of my charity. I promise you won't be disappointed.

english: At the prices I keep, I'm practically giving things away!
french: Vu les prix que je pratique, c'est comme si c'était gratuit !
russian: При моих ценах можно сказать, что отдаю товар бесплатно!
bulgarian: At the prices I keep, I'm practically giving things away!

english: Because today, you're here... and so is the deal of your dreams.
french: En effet, tu es là aujourd'hui... tout comme l'affaire dont tu as toujours rêvé.
russian: Потому что сегодня вам повстречалась... покупка вашей мечты.
bulgarian: Because today, you're here... and so is the deal of your dreams.

english: Do you believe in destiny, my friend? You've certainly made me a believer.
french: Est-ce que tu crois au destin, mon ami<he></he><she>e</she><they>·e</they> ? Parce que grâce à toi, moi oui.
russian: Верите ли вы в судьбу, друг мой? Благодаря вам я и сам поверил.
bulgarian: Do you believe in destiny, my friend? You've certainly made me a believer.

english: But for you? My favorite customer? Oh, it's all on the table.
french: Mais en ce qui te concerne, et puisque tu fais partie de mes clients préférés, tu as le droit de voir tout ce que j'ai à proposer.
russian: Но для вас, моего любимого клиента, — всё, что хотите!
bulgarian: But for you? My favorite customer? Oh, it's all on the table.

english: Now, I wouldn't sell my wares to just anyone...
french: Sache que je ne propose pas mes marchandises à n'importe qui...
russian: Знаете, я не стану предлагать свой товар кому попало...
bulgarian: Now, I wouldn't sell my wares to just anyone...

english: Cheers to a healthy economy, [Ari]!
french: Œuvrons pour une économie saine, [Ari].
russian: За здоровую экономику, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Cheers to a healthy economy, [Ari]!

english: I've got some very special items in stock, and I was thinking of you when I marked these low, low prices.
french: J'ai des articles très spéciaux en stock, et c'est précisément à toi que je pensais en fixant ces prix ridiculement bas.
russian: У меня есть для вас крайне необычные товары. И я подумал о вас, когда вешал эти ультранизкие ценники.
bulgarian: I've got some very special items in stock, and I was thinking of you when I marked these low, low prices.

english: Everything you've heard about my shop... it's all true.
french: Tout ce que tu as entendu au sujet de ma boutique... est la pure vérité.
russian: Всё, что вы слышали о моей лавке... чистая правда.
bulgarian: Everything you've heard about my shop... it's all true.

english: I have the exact thing you're looking for, at exactly the right price.
french: J'ai pile ce que tu cherches, et au prix juste.
russian: У меня есть именно то, что вам нужно, по самой выгодной цене.
bulgarian: I have the exact thing you're looking for, at exactly the right price.

english: If you've come here, then you must have heard the rumors.
french: Si tu es là, c'est sans doute que tu as entendu les rumeurs.
russian: Раз вы пришли сюда, значит, знакомы со слухами.
bulgarian: If you've come here, then you must have heard the rumors.

english: I recommend cozying up to some piping hot deals.
french: Les bonnes affaires que j'ai à te proposer vont te réchauffer le cœur.
russian: Рекомендую согреться у моих огненно-жарких скидок.
bulgarian: I recommend cozying up to some piping hot deals.

english: It's quite chilly these days, isn't it my friend?
french: Il fait un peu frais ces jours-ci, tu ne trouves pas ?
russian: Морозные деньки наступили, не так ли, друг мой?
bulgarian: It's quite chilly these days, isn't it my friend?

english: These prices? They're the real deal.
french: Mon prix, c'est le juste prix.
russian: Мои цены? Это настоящая выгода.
bulgarian: These prices? They're the real deal.

english: Oh, I'm not like those other merchants...
french: Oh, je ne suis pas comme les autres marchands...
russian: О, я не таков, как другие торговцы...
bulgarian: Oh, I'm not like those other merchants...

english: All at a price that makes you gasp at my generosity and recount it to future generations.
french: Et le tout à un prix stupéfiant de générosité, un prix dont tu parleras encore à tes descendants.
russian: А все цены заставят вас разинуть рот от моей щедрости и рассказывать о ней потомкам.
bulgarian: All at a price that makes you gasp at my generosity and recount it to future generations.

english: It's my life's work to see the right items get into the right hands...
french: Mon but, dans la vie, c'est que le bon article atterrisse entre les mains du client qui en a besoin...
russian: Дело моей жизни — доставить правильный товар в правильные руки...
bulgarian: It's my life's work to see the right items get into the right hands...

english: That's the Wheedle guarantee!
french: C'est la garantie Wheedle !
russian: Даю гарантию Хлюста!
bulgarian: That's the Wheedle guarantee!

english: The leaves may change in autumn, but my prices? They'll always be a rock-bottom bargain.
french: Les feuilles changent en automne, contrairement à mes prix. Ils restent les plus bas du marché.
russian: Листва на деревьях меняется осенью, но мои цены? Они всегда остаются на самом дне!
bulgarian: The leaves may change in autumn, but my prices? They'll always be a rock-bottom bargain.

english: Why not leave it with me, and go home with something from my carefully curated inventory?
french: Pourquoi ne pas me les laisser en contrepartie d'un de ces articles spécialement sélectionnés ?
russian: Почему бы не оставить их у меня и не выбрать взамен что-нибудь из моего тщательно подобранного каталога?
bulgarian: Why not leave it with me, and go home with something from my carefully curated inventory?

english: I'm happy to shoulder the burden for you.
french: Je serai ravi de t'en délester.
russian: С радостью избавлю вас от этого груза.
bulgarian: I'm happy to shoulder the burden for you.

english: I've been thinking about your health, [Ari]... all that tesserae you're carrying looks quite heavy.
french: Je me préoccupe pour ta santé, [Ari].. Tous ces tesserae que tu portes doivent peser horriblement lourd.
russian: Я задумался о вашем здоровье, [Ari]... Запас тессер, который вы таскаете, такой тяжеловесный.
bulgarian: I've been thinking about your health, [Ari]... all that tesserae you're carrying looks quite heavy.

english: I've got several kinds, actually. Be sure to try them all!
french: D'ailleurs, j'en propose différentes sortes. N'hésite pas à les essayer !
russian: У меня есть разные виды. Обязательно попробуй их все!
bulgarian: I've got several kinds, actually. Be sure to try them all!

english: All around the Capital, they call me a $Snake Oil$ salesman... and I confess that it's true!
french: À la capitale, on me surnomme le vendeur d'$huile de couleuvre$ et c'est vrai !
russian: Вокруг столицы все говорят, что моё $змеиное масло$ — шарлатанское средство... Но это неправда!
bulgarian: All around the Capital, they call me a $Snake Oil$ salesman... and I confess that it's true!

english: I've got deals so hot you could fry an egg on them, [Ari]! Have a look!
french: Mes prix sont si bas qu'on pourrait les piétiner sans s'en rendre compte. Jette donc un œil, [Ari] !
russian: Такие горячие предложения, что можно пожарить омлет! Только взгляните, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I've got deals so hot you could fry an egg on them, [Ari]! Have a look!

english: In the summer, I like my shirt how I like my prices... unbuttoned.
french: En été, j'aime que mes vêtements soient aussi légers que mes prix.
russian: Когда летом приходят жаркие дни... у меня наступают жаркие предложения!
bulgarian: In the summer, I like my shirt how I like my prices... unbuttoned.

english: I've been unfairly maligned many times, but I promise you I'm an honest businessman.
french: J'ai souvent été traité de manière totalement injustifiée. Je te jure que je suis un vendeur des plus honnêtes.
russian: Меня много раз несправедливо оговаривали, но уверяю вас, я честный делец.
bulgarian: I've been unfairly maligned many times, but I promise you I'm an honest businessman.

english: Now, you may have heard some rumors about me.
french: Alors, tu as peut-être entendu certaines rumeurs à mon sujet.
russian: Возможно, до вас добирались обо мне слухи.
bulgarian: Now, you may have heard some rumors about me.

english: But worry not, you're on the VIP list. So have a look!
french: Mais ne t'en fais pas, tu fais partie des VIP. Alors, n'hésite pas à jeter un coup d'œil !
russian: Но не волнуйтесь, вы клиент премиум-класса. Так что присмотритесь!
bulgarian: But worry not, you're on the VIP list. So have a look!

english: My store is quite exclusive, [Ari]...
french: Ma boutique est assez sélecte, [Ari]..
russian: У меня весьма эксклюзивный магазин, [Ari]...
bulgarian: My store is quite exclusive, [Ari]...

english: Are you ready to be wowed and amazed!?
french: Tu veux connaître le véritable sens du mot « émerveillement » ?
russian: Готовы увидеть нечто потрясающее, нечто невероятное!?
bulgarian: Are you ready to be wowed and amazed!?

english: Believe me, you won't find items like this available anywhere else.
french: Tu ne trouveras ces articles nulle part ailleurs, crois-moi.
russian: Поверьте, вы не найдёте таких товаров больше нигде.
bulgarian: Believe me, you won't find items like this available anywhere else.

english: And at such reasonable prices, too!
french: Et surtout à des prix aussi raisonnables !
russian: И по таким доступным ценам!
bulgarian: And at such reasonable prices, too!

english: I'm practically giving them away!
french: C'est presque comme si je les donnais !
russian: Я практически даром их отдаю!
bulgarian: I'm practically giving them away!

english: Step right up, #step right up#!
french: Approche, #approche# !
russian: Подходите, #подходите#!
bulgarian: Step right up, #step right up#!

english: Alas, [Ari]... the time for deals has passed. I'll never forget the bargains we shared.
french: Malheureusement, [Ari], le temps des bonnes affaires est derrière nous. Je n'oublierai jamais toutes les occasions en or dont tu as bénéficié.
russian: К несчастью, [Ari]... пора скидок закончилась. Мне никогда не забыть наши сделки.
bulgarian: Alas, [Ari]... the time for deals has passed. I'll never forget the bargains we shared.

english: Ridiculous. What are all those muscles even for?
french: C'est ridicule. À quoi ça lui sert, tous ces muscles ?
russian: Безобразие. Зачем ещё тогда такая гора мышц?
bulgarian: Ridiculous. What are all those muscles even for?

english: Nora did not approve my proposal for Olric to pack all the booths after the Market day ends.
french: J'avais proposé à Olric de remballer tous les stands après le marché, mais Nora n'était pas d'accord.
russian: Нора не одобрила моё предложение отправить Ольрика собирать все лавки по окончании базарного дня.
bulgarian: Nora did not approve my proposal for Olric to pack all the booths after the Market day ends.

english: I'm packing the booth, but come back some other Saturday and we'll talk business.
french: Je suis en train de tout ranger, mais reviens un de ces samedis et nous pourrons parler affaires.
russian: Я уже собираю вещи, но приходите в другую субботу, и мы поговорим по делу.
bulgarian: I'm packing the booth, but come back some other Saturday and we'll talk business.

english: Oh, [Ari]. You've caught me without a deal in sight.
french: Oh, [Ari]. Je n'ai plus rien à te proposer.
russian: О, [Ari]. Вы подловили меня без делового предложения.
bulgarian: Oh, [Ari]. You've caught me without a deal in sight.

english: But the last time I drank out of the town fountain, I was scolded for 'setting a bad example for the children'.
french: Mais la dernière fois que j'ai voulu me désaltérer à la fontaine de la ville, on m'a repris parce que je donnais un mauvais exemple aux enfants.
russian: Но в прошлый раз, когда я пил из фонтана, меня отругали за то, что «подаю плохой пример детям».
bulgarian: But the last time I drank out of the town fountain, I was scolded for 'setting a bad example for the children'.

english: Maybe the children should wise up! It's free water!
french: Ces enfants devraient grandir un peu ! L'eau est gratuite !
russian: Пусть дети смотрят как следует! Это же бесплатная вода!
bulgarian: Maybe the children should wise up! It's free water!

english: Packing up the booth certainly works up a thirst.
french: Remballer mon stand me donne toujours soif.
russian: От такой работы, как сбор лавки, всегда хочется пить.
bulgarian: Packing up the booth certainly works up a thirst.

english: Unacceptable! I'm filing a complaint! The King will hear about this snow in my box!
french: C'est intolérable ! Je vais porter plainte ! Cette histoire de neige dans mes caisses remontera au roi !
russian: Это неприемлемо! Я подам жалобу! Сам король узнает, что у меня в ящиках снег!
bulgarian: Unacceptable! I'm filing a complaint! The King will hear about this snow in my box!

english: Oh, it melted.
french: Oh, elle a fondu.
russian: Ой, уже растаял.
bulgarian: Oh, it melted.

english: Snow keeps getting into my boxes while I'm packing up!
french: La neige s'infiltre dans mes caisses pendant que je range !
russian: Пока я собираю вещи, в мои ящики засыпается снег!
bulgarian: Snow keeps getting into my boxes while I'm packing up!

english: They keep me warm, and the style? Oh, the style.
french: Ils me tiennent chaud. Et je ne te parle même pas de l'allure.
russian: Они тёплые и весьма стильные. Ах, какие стильные!
bulgarian: They keep me warm, and the style? Oh, the style.

english: I knew I'd be packing the booth up on a cold winter's evening, so I commissioned these gloves from Louis.
french: Je savais que j'allais devoir remballer lors des soirées d'hiver, alors j'ai commandé ces gants à Louis.
russian: Я знал, что придётся собирать лавку холодным зимним вечером, поэтому заказал у Луи эти перчатки.
bulgarian: I knew I'd be packing the booth up on a cold winter's evening, so I commissioned these gloves from Louis.

english: Another Saturday Market comes to a close. See you at the next one, my most favorite customer!
french: Un autre marché qui s'achève. J'espère qu'on se verra la prochaine fois, fidèle client<she>e</she><he></he><they>·e</they> !
russian: Вот и ещё один Субботний базар подошёл к концу. Увидимся в следующий раз, мой клиент номер один!
bulgarian: Another Saturday Market comes to a close. See you at the next one, my most favorite customer!

english: But worry not. Wheedle's circus of deals will return!
french: Mais ne t'inquiète pas. Le grand bazar aux affaires de Wheedle sera vite de retour !
russian: Но не волнуйтесь. Карнавал скидок Хлюста вернётся через неделю!
bulgarian: But worry not. Wheedle's circus of deals will return!

english: So sorry, the store is closed while I'm breaking down the booth, [Ari].
french: Je suis navré, la boutique est fermée pendant que je démonte mon stand, [Ari].
russian: Прошу прощения, моя лавка закрыта, [Ari], я её уже собираю.
bulgarian: So sorry, the store is closed while I'm breaking down the booth, [Ari].

english: Most of the clientele here don't know a good bargain when they see one.
french: Mes clients de Mistria n'ont pas l'œil pour les bonnes affaires.
russian: Большая часть местной клиентуры не может распознать хорошее предложение.
bulgarian: Most of the clientele here don't know a good bargain when they see one.

english: Present company excluded, of course.
french: À part toi, bien sûr.
russian: За исключением присутствующих, разумеется.
bulgarian: Present company excluded, of course.

english: Packing up the booth takes a long time when your inventory is as exclusive as mine.
french: Ranger son stand prend un temps fou quand on propose des marchandises aussi exclusives que les miennes.
russian: Сбор вещей — небыстрое занятие с такими эксклюзивными товарами, как у меня.
bulgarian: Packing up the booth takes a long time when your inventory is as exclusive as mine.

english: Not me. They're quite touchy about open tabs.
french: Moi non. Ils n'aiment pas trop qu'on leur laisse une ardoise.
russian: Я — нет. Они там слишком чувствительно относятся к оплате в долг.
bulgarian: Not me. They're quite touchy about open tabs.

english: Or so I've heard.
french: Enfin, c'est ce qu'on m'a dit.
russian: Мне рассказывали.
bulgarian: Or so I've heard.

english: Now that the day's over, will you head to the Inn?
french: Comme la journée est terminée, tu vas aller à l'auberge ?
russian: День подходит к концу. Собираетесь пойти в трактир?
bulgarian: Now that the day's over, will you head to the Inn?

english: But his little brother intervened. Apparently you can't pay people with rocks these days.
french: Mais son petit frère est intervenu. Apparemment, on ne peut plus payer les gens avec des pierres, de nos jours.
russian: И вдруг вмешался его младший брат. Оказывается, камни нынче не принимаются к оплате!
bulgarian: But his little brother intervened. Apparently you can't pay people with rocks these days.

english: You know, I tried to hire that brawny fellow Olric to carry my things after the Market closed.
french: Tu sais, j'ai essayé d'embaucher ce type costaud, Olric, pour transporter mes affaires après le marché.
russian: Представляете, я хотел нанять того мускулистого парня, Ольрика, чтобы он перетащил мне вещи после закрытия.
bulgarian: You know, I tried to hire that brawny fellow Olric to carry my things after the Market closed.

english: Look forward to it, won't you?
french: Tu as hâte de voir ce que je trouverai, hein ?
russian: Вы уже ждёте обновок?
bulgarian: Look forward to it, won't you?

english: After I'm packed up, I'll be heading to the Capital to seek out more deals from my... very reputable suppliers.
french: Une fois tout remballé, je retournerai à la capitale en quête de bonnes affaires auprès de fournisseurs très... réputés.
russian: Когда я закончу сборы, я поеду в столицу налаживать контакты с моими... крайне надёжными поставщиками.
bulgarian: After I'm packed up, I'll be heading to the Capital to seek out more deals from my... very reputable suppliers.

english: If I could bottle and sell it, I know just how I'd price it.
french: Si je pouvais la mettre en bouteille, je sais exactement à quel prix je la vendrais.
russian: Вот бы его запаковать и продать, я уж знаю ему цену.
bulgarian: If I could bottle and sell it, I know just how I'd price it.

english: I was packing up and oh, that evening breeze is delightful...
french: J'étais en train de remballer, quand je me suis rendu compte que cette légère brise de fin de journée était divine...
russian: Я собирал вещи и тут — ах, такой чудесный ветерок...
bulgarian: I was packing up and oh, that evening breeze is delightful...

english: Tsk. As if they could afford it.
french: Tss. Comme s'ils avaient les moyens de s'en acheter.
russian: Пф. Как будто оно им по карману.
bulgarian: Tsk. As if they could afford it.

english: Those children were here while the market was open, daring each other to drink my precious $Snake Oil$!
french: Des gamins traînaient pendant le marché. Ils se mettaient au défi de boire ma précieuse $huile de couleuvre$.
russian: Эти дети болтались тут, пока был базар, и обсуждали, кто на спор выпьет моё ценное $змеиное масло$!
bulgarian: Those children were here while the market was open, daring each other to drink my precious $Snake Oil$!

english: Well, I'm sorry to say I'm closing up for the day. But do come back next time! Tata!
french: Eh bien, désolé, mais la journée est terminée, je plie boutique. Mais reviens la prochaine fois ! À bientôt !
russian: Увы, на сегодня моя лавка уже закрыта. Но заходите в следующий раз! Та-да!
bulgarian: Well, I'm sorry to say I'm closing up for the day. But do come back next time! Tata!

english: Oho, you can't stay away from a bargain, can you?
french: Oh oh, tu as l'œil pour les bonnes affaires, n'est-ce pas ?
russian: Ого, не можете пройти мимо хорошего предложения?
bulgarian: Oho, you can't stay away from a bargain, can you?

english: How can I be expected to make deals under these conditions?
french: Comment je suis censé faire des affaires dans ces conditions ?
russian: Как прикажете мне в таких условиях вести коммерцию?
bulgarian: How can I be expected to make deals under these conditions?

english: Packing up the booth is my least favorite part of a Market Day.
french: S'il y a bien un truc qui m'horripile lors des marchés, c'est de devoir remballer mon stand.
russian: Сборы — моя самая нелюбимая часть базарного дня.
bulgarian: Packing up the booth is my least favorite part of a Market Day.

english: It's not often I meet someone who really appreciates a good bottle of $Snake Oil$.
french: Ce n'est pas souvent que je croise quelqu'un qui apprécie une bonne bouteille d'$huile de couleuvre$.
russian: Я редко встречаю настоящих ценителей $змеиного масла$.
bulgarian: It's not often I meet someone who really appreciates a good bottle of $Snake Oil$.

english: That strange woman, Seridia, was impressed with my merchandise.
french: Cette femme étrange, Seridia, a été impressionnée par ma marchandise.
russian: Эту странную женщину, Серидию, впечатлили мои товары.
bulgarian: That strange woman, Seridia, was impressed with my merchandise.

english: You've given me the greatest birthday gift of all... a deal of my very own!
french: C'est le plus beau cadeau d'anniversaire qui soit... Une affaire en or rien que pour moi !
russian: Это лучший день рождения в моей жизни... Подарочная акция специально для меня!
bulgarian: You've given me the greatest birthday gift of all... a deal of my very own!

english: For me! My my! Normally I'm the one doling out deals!
french: C'est pour moi ? Ça alors ! C'est moi qui offre les bonnes affaires, normalement !
russian: Это мне? Ну и ну! Обычно выгодные предложения делаю я!
bulgarian: For me! My my! Normally I'm the one doling out deals!

english: I'll take this, for... safekeeping.
french: Bon, je les prends... Pour les mettre en lieu sûr.
russian: Я её заберу... для сохранности.
bulgarian: I'll take this, for... safekeeping.

english: And perhaps, for kindling...
french: Ou pour allumer le feu...
russian: Или, может, для растопки...
bulgarian: And perhaps, for kindling...

english: A $Criminal Confession$! This isn't mine, who said it was?
french: Des $aveux$ ? Qui iraient penser que ce sont les miens ?
russian: $Повинная преступника$! Это не моё, кто вам такое сказал?
bulgarian: A $Criminal Confession$! This isn't mine, who said it was?

english: Is this a regift? No, don't answer... I understand. I'll find a use for it.
french: Tu cherchais à t'en débarrasser ? Pas la peine de répondre... Je comprends. J'y trouverai bien une utilité.
russian: Вы передариваете, потому что вам не нужно? Лучше не отвечайте... Я всё понял. Я куда-нибудь пристрою.
bulgarian: Is this a regift? No, don't answer... I understand. I'll find a use for it.

english: There's nothing I love more than a little wheed!
french: J'adore ce type de fibre !
russian: Кто вам рассказал, что лист травы — мой любимый подарок?
bulgarian: There's nothing I love more than a little wheed!

english: [Ari], how did you know!
french: [Ari], comment tu as su ?
russian: [Ari], откуда вы знаете?
bulgarian: [Ari], how did you know!

english: Very nice, very nice. I'll take it!
french: C'est vraiment très gentil, j'accepte !
russian: Хорошо, очень хорошо. Это я заберу!
bulgarian: Very nice, very nice. I'll take it!

english: How did you know, gold is my favorite color! Hu hu!
french: Qui t'a dit que le doré était ma couleur préférée ? Hin hin.
russian: Золотой — мой любимый цвет, как вы догадались? Хе-хе!
bulgarian: How did you know, gold is my favorite color! Hu hu!

english: Just like how I appreciate you, my number one greatest customer!
french: Tout comme je t'apprécie toi, il n'y a pas deux clients comme toi !
russian: Как я ценю вас, мой самый лучший клиент номер один!
bulgarian: Just like how I appreciate you, my number one greatest customer!

english: Oho, how delightful! It's so good to be appreciated.
french: Oh oh, quel ravissement ! Comme c'est bon de se sentir apprécié !
russian: Ого, как замечательно! Приятно, когда тебя ценят.
bulgarian: Oho, how delightful! It's so good to be appreciated.

english: Look at that sparkle! Just like the gleam of a happy customer's smile!
french: C'est ravissant ! Beau comme le sourire d'un client satisfait !
russian: Только посмотрите, как блестит! Словно улыбка счастливого покупателя!
bulgarian: Look at that sparkle! Just like the gleam of a happy customer's smile!

english: Ah, I see. Well, waste not, want not!
french: Ah, je vois. Enfin, rien ne se perd, comme on dit.
russian: А давай. Может, в хозяйстве пригодится.
bulgarian: Ah, I see. Well, waste not, want not!
